caption:
How to stop AI making things up about your business: make it ask questions first

When AI doesn't know something, it fills the gap with a guess. That's where "fully insured" and "affordable rates" come from, even if you never said them.

Add one line to your prompt:

"I need [WHAT YOU NEED]. Before you write anything, ask me 3 questions. Then write it using only my answers."

I tried it for a flyer for an example window-cleaning business. The 3 questions: who it's for, what makes you different, what people should do next. Three short answers later, the flyer led with "Same cleaner. Every visit." because that's what I told it.

Tip: for bigger jobs (About page, service descriptions), add "one at a time" so it feels like a chat.

Send this to someone who still fixes AI's guesses by hand. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.
